+    def _valid_time_stamp(value):
+        """Return a ZIP timestamp suitable for mktime, or the ZIP epoch."""
+        epoch = (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
+        if not isinstance(value, str):
+            return epoch
+        match = ZIP_TIMESTAMP_RE.fullmatch(value)
+        if match is None:
+            return epoch
+
+        year, month, day, hour, minute, second = map(int, match.groups())
+        if not 1980 <= year <= 2107 or not 1 <= month <= 12:
+            return epoch
+        if not 1 <= day <= calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]:
+            return epoch
+        if not 0 <= hour <= 23 or not 0 <= minute <= 59 or not 0 <= second <= 59:
+            return epoch
+
+        # Let mktime determine daylight saving time, as strptime did.
+        return (year, month, day, hour, minute, second, 0, 0, -1)
